definition_zh: 竞争的；有竞争力的；争强好胜的
definition_en: relating to competition, cheap enough to beat rivals, or wanting very much to win
core_image: 跑道上的人侧头盯着旁边的选手，脚下加快
scene: 招聘会上，同一个岗位前排了很长的队。The job market is highly competitive this year.
sceneCN: 这里 competitive 指「竞争激烈的」（第 1 个义项：充满竞争的）；句意是今年的就业市场竞争十分激烈。

pos.zh: 竞争的；有竞争力的；争强好胜的

senses.title: Full of competition
senses.definition: involving people or firms trying to win
senses.definitionCN: 涉及人或公司争胜的
senses.example: The software market is fiercely competitive.
senses.exampleCN: 软件市场竞争激烈。
senses.why: An adjective from competition simply describes the arena where rivals meet.
senses.whyCN: 由 competition 来的形容词，只描述对手相遇的场地。

senses.title: Good enough to win
senses.definition: low or good enough to beat what rivals offer
senses.definitionCN: 低或好到能胜过对手的
senses.example: They offered a competitive price on the laptop.
senses.exampleCN: 他们给这台笔记本报了个有竞争力的价格。
senses.why: From describing the contest, the word moves to describing a winning position in it.
senses.whyCN: 从描述比赛，转为描述在比赛中占优的位置。

senses.title: Eager to win
senses.definition: wanting very much to beat others
senses.definitionCN: 非常想胜过别人的
senses.example: He is too competitive to enjoy a friendly game.
senses.exampleCN: 他太争强好胜，玩不成轻松的游戏。
senses.why: The same drive can be praised in a market and frowned on at a dinner table.
senses.whyCN: 同一种冲劲在市场里被称赞，在饭桌上却被皱眉。

intro.en: Competitive adds the ending -ive to the Latin base of compete, naming what belongs to rivalry.
intro.cn: competitive 在 compete 的拉丁词基上加后缀 -ive，表示属于争胜的东西。

items.en: Competere meant to seek the same thing as another.
items.cn: competere 意为与别人追求同一样东西。

items.en: Competitivus described things that belonged to a contest.
items.cn: competitivus 描述属于争胜的事物。

items.en: English competitive first described sports and exams.
items.cn: 英语 competitive 最初描述体育与考试。

items.en: Trade writers applied it to prices and markets.
items.cn: 商业作者把它用到价格与市场上。

items.en: It now also describes a person who hates to lose.
items.cn: 如今它也用来形容输不起的人。

note.en: The look-alike group holds other compete forms, and the meaning group separates ambitious drive from an aggressive manner and a cheap price.
note.cn: 形近组收的是 compete 的其他形式，近义组分辨雄心、强势作风与低廉价格。

entries.definition: to strive against others
having enough skill for a task
a contest or a rivalry
determined to succeed
very forceful in pursuing a goal
low in price

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a sideways glance at a rival, then move to a price that wins and to a temper that must win.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从斜眼看向对手开始，再走到能取胜的价格与非赢不可的性子。

normal.en: Competitive carries -ive, so it describes a field full of competing.
normal.cn: competitive 带着 -ive，所以它描述一个充满竞争的场域。

normal.en: A competitive price is a price that competes and wins.
normal.cn: 有竞争力的价格，就是能参与竞争并胜出的价格。

normal.en: A competitive person keeps score even in the garden.
normal.cn: 好胜的人连在花园里也要计分。

normal.en: Competitive is the adjective, competitiveness the quality.
normal.cn: competitive 是形容词，competitiveness 是那种性质。

normal.en: The phrase competitive edge is the small gap that wins.
normal.cn: competitive edge 就是决定胜负的那一点点差距。

abstract.en: Picture a runner half a step ahead, breathing hard.
abstract.cn: 想象跑者领先半步，喘着粗气。

abstract.en: Picture two price tags, one lower by a few coins.
abstract.cn: 想象两个价签，一个低了几枚硬币。

abstract.en: Picture a chess player refusing a draw.
abstract.cn: 想象棋手拒绝和棋。

examples.en: Small shops struggle to stay competitive.
examples.cn: 小店很难保持竞争力。

examples.en: She has a competitive streak that shows in every game.
examples.cn: 她有一股好胜劲，每场游戏都看得出来。

examples.en: The hotel offers competitive rates in winter.
examples.cn: 这家酒店冬季价格很有竞争力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 competitive 记成 compete（竞争）加 itive：带着竞争劲儿的，就是有竞争力的、好胜的。

root: 源自拉丁语 competere（一起追求），加形容词后缀 -ive，本义属于竞争的，后引申为有竞争力的与争强好胜的。

sensesIntro.en: From the arena itself, to a winning price, and finally to the temper that must win.
sensesIntro.cn: 从场地本身，到能取胜的价格，最后到非赢不可的性子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a runner glancing sideways at a rival, feet quickening.
core.cn: 核心意象：跑道上的人侧头盯着旁边的选手，脚下加快。

branches.en: The first sense simply describes a crowded field.
branches.cn: 第一个义项只是描述一个人挤人的场域。

branches.en: A price earns the word when it can beat the shop next door.
branches.cn: 价格能压过隔壁店时，才配得上这个词。

branches.en: The same drive turns inward and becomes a temperament.
branches.cn: 同一种冲劲转向内里，就成了一种性情。

branches.en: A market is competitive because its offers compete.
branches.cn: 市场之所以叫竞争性，是因为其中的报价在相互竞争。

branches.en: Winning prices and winning tempers share one source.
branches.cn: 取胜的价格与好胜的性子同出一源。

intro.en: Competitive takes the Latin base compet- and the adjective ending -itive.
intro.cn: competitive 由拉丁词基 compet- 加形容词后缀 -itive 构成。

latinIntro.en: Every form in this family carries the seeking base pet-.
latinIntro.cn: 这一族的每个形式都带着表示追求的 pet- 词基。

items.meaning: in a way that competes well
items.example: The team is priced competitively.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队的报价很有竞争力。

items.example: The report ranks national competitiveness.
items.exampleCN: 这份报告给各国竞争力排名。

items.example: Every competitor received a badge.
items.exampleCN: 每位参赛者都领到一个徽章。

items.example: Two competitors withdrew at the start.
items.exampleCN: 两名对手在起点退出。

items.example: They compete on service, not price.
items.exampleCN: 他们比的是服务而不是价格。

items.example: She competes with the best.
items.exampleCN: 她与最强者竞争。

items.example: Competing claims confused the buyers.
items.exampleCN: 相互竞争的说法让买家糊涂了。

items.example: Competition keeps prices low.
items.exampleCN: 竞争让价格保持低位。

definition_en: to say that you are unhappy or not satisfied about something
core_image: 饭桌上有人皱着眉头把盘子往前一推
scene: 楼上整夜装修，邻居第二天一早就去了物业。She complained about the noise for a week.
sceneCN: 这里 complain 指「投诉；抱怨」（第 1 个义项：表达不满）；句意是她为这噪音抱怨了一周。

senses.title: To say you are unhappy
senses.definition: to say that something is wrong or annoying
senses.definitionCN: 说出某事不对或令人烦
senses.example: He complained about the cold soup.
senses.exampleCN: 他抱怨汤是凉的。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply giving voice to a private displeasure.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项只是把心里的不快说出来。

senses.title: To make a formal protest
senses.definition: to tell an authority that something is wrong
senses.definitionCN: 向管理方说明某事有问题
senses.example: Guests complained to the manager about the room.
senses.exampleCN: 客人向经理投诉房间问题。
senses.why: When the listener has power to act, a complaint becomes a formal claim.
senses.whyCN: 当听者有权处理，抱怨就成了正式投诉。

senses.title: To describe a pain or illness
senses.definition: to say that you feel pain somewhere
senses.definitionCN: 说自己某处疼痛
senses.example: She complained of a headache all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她一上午都在说头痛。
senses.why: Pain, once spoken, becomes a symptom a doctor can read.
senses.whyCN: 疼痛一旦说出，就成了医生能读的症状。

intro.en: Complain comes from Latin plangere, to beat the breast in grief, through Old French complaindre.
intro.cn: complain 经古法语 complaindre 上溯到拉丁语 plangere，意为悲伤地捶胸。

items.en: Plangere meant to strike the breast and lament.
items.cn: plangere 意为捶胸哀叹。

items.en: The word shifted from mourning to voicing any grief.
items.cn: 这个词从哀悼转向说出任何悲伤。

items.en: Old French complaindre brought it into daily speech.
items.cn: 古法语 complaindre 把它带进日常语言。

items.en: English complain first meant to lament a loss.
items.cn: 英语 complain 最初指为损失而哀叹。

items.en: It settled into grumbling, formal protest and naming a pain.
items.cn: 后来它稳定为抱怨、正式投诉与说出病痛。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to complain, and the meaning group ranks grumbling, protesting and formal objection.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 complain 形状相近的词，近义组排出嘟囔、抗议与正式反对。

entries.definition: a statement of dissatisfaction
to finish something
a business firm
to complain in a quiet, bad-tempered way
to say strongly that something is wrong
to express disagreement

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a plate pushed away, then move to a formal complaint and to pain that is finally spoken.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被推开的盘子开始，再走到正式投诉以及终于说出口的疼痛。

normal.en: Complain about a thing, complain to a person, complain of a pain.
normal.cn: 对事情用 complain about，对人用 complain to，说疼痛用 complain of。

normal.en: The noun is complaint, and it is one letter away from complain.
normal.cn: 名词是 complaint，与 complain 只差一点。

normal.en: A complainer finds a flaw in every meal.
normal.cn: 爱抱怨的人每顿饭都能挑出毛病。

normal.en: Complaining to a manager turns a grumble into a case.
normal.cn: 向经理抱怨，就把嘟囔变成了一桩案子。

normal.en: The old root means to beat the breast, so the word began in grief.
normal.cn: 古老词根意为捶胸，所以这个词起于悲伤。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon set down a little too hard.
abstract.cn: 想象勺子被放得稍重了一点。

abstract.en: Picture a guest writing a long note at the front desk.
abstract.cn: 想象客人在前台写一张长长的意见。

abstract.en: Picture a patient pointing at the chest and frowning.
abstract.cn: 想象病人指着胸口皱眉。

examples.en: Customers complained about the slow service.
examples.cn: 顾客抱怨服务太慢。

examples.en: Stop complaining and help me carry this.
examples.cn: 别抱怨了，帮我抬一下这个。

examples.en: He complained of chest pain at midnight.
examples.cn: 他半夜说胸口疼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 complain 记成 com（一起）加 plain（捶胸）：一起捶着胸说委屈，就是抱怨。

root: 源自拉丁语 plangere（捶胸哀叹）与古法语 complaindre，本义是为不幸而捶胸出声，后引申为抱怨、投诉与诉说病痛。

sensesIntro.en: From voicing a small annoyance, to a formal claim, and finally to naming a pain.
sensesIntro.cn: 从说出小小的不快，到正式投诉，最后到说出病痛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone at a table pushing the plate away with a frown.
core.cn: 核心意象：饭桌上有人皱着眉头把盘子往前一推。

branches.en: Saying you are unhappy is the plainest sense.
branches.cn: 说出自己不开心，是最朴素的义项。

branches.en: A complaint to someone in power becomes official.
branches.cn: 向有权处理的人抱怨，就变成正式的。

branches.en: Pain spoken aloud becomes a symptom.
branches.cn: 疼痛说出口，就成了症状。

branches.en: Both senses begin with the same displeasure.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从同一种不快开始。

branches.en: Both hand the trouble to someone who can act.
branches.cn: 两者都把麻烦交给能处理的人。

intro.en: Complain is a verb from Old French complaindre, built on the Latin lament base plangere.
intro.cn: complain 是来自古法语 complaindre 的动词，建立在拉丁语表示哀叹的词基 plangere 上。

latinIntro.en: The same root survives in plangent, a sound that is loud and mournful.
latinIntro.cn: 同一个词根还留在 plangent 里，指响亮而哀伤的声音。

items.meaning: says he or she is unhappy
items.example: He complains about everything.
items.exampleCN: 他什么都抱怨。

items.example: They complained to the front desk.
items.exampleCN: 他们向前台投诉了。

items.example: Complaining will not fix the lift.
items.exampleCN: 抱怨修不好电梯。

items.example: The manager knew every complainer by name.
items.exampleCN: 经理叫得出每个爱抱怨的客人的名字。

items.example: Her complaint was handled quickly.
items.exampleCN: 她的投诉很快得到处理。

items.example: The hotel logged ten complaints.
items.exampleCN: 酒店记录了十条投诉。

items.meaning: a person who makes a formal complaint
items.example: The complainant asked for a refund.
items.exampleCN: 投诉人要求退款。

items.example: She answered complainingly.
items.exampleCN: 她抱怨地回答。

definition_en: a statement that you are not satisfied, or an illness that troubles you
core_image: 信箱里塞着一张写满字的意见卡
scene: 客房的空调响个不停，前台记下房号并派人上去。The hotel received three complaints about the lift.
sceneCN: 这里 complaint 指「投诉」（第 2 个义项：正式反映问题）；句意是酒店收到三条关于电梯的投诉。

senses.title: A statement of dissatisfaction
senses.definition: a statement that something is wrong or annoying
senses.definitionCN: 说明某事有问题或令人烦的话
senses.example: My main complaint is the noise at night.
senses.exampleCN: 我主要的抱怨是夜里的噪音。
senses.why: The noun holds the words that the verb lets out.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词装着动词说出口的那些话。

senses.title: A formal protest
senses.definition: an official statement that something is wrong
senses.definitionCN: 向管理方正式说明问题的陈述
senses.example: She filed a complaint with the manager.
senses.exampleCN: 她向经理提交了投诉。
senses.why: Written down and handed to someone with power, a grumble becomes a case.
senses.whyCN: 写下来交给有权处理的人，嘟囔就成了一桩案子。

senses.title: An illness
senses.definition: an illness or a pain in part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 身体某处的病或疼痛
senses.example: The doctor asked about her stomach complaint.
senses.exampleCN: 医生问起她的胃病。
senses.why: A long tradition calls the body's troubles a complaint of the flesh.
senses.whyCN: 很久以来的说法把身体的不适称作肉身的抱怨。

intro.en: Complaint comes from Old French complainte, a noun of lament built on Latin plangere, to beat the breast.
intro.cn: complaint 来自古法语 complainte，这个表示哀叹的名词建立在拉丁语 plangere（捶胸）之上。

items.en: Plangere meant to strike the breast in sorrow.
items.cn: plangere 意为悲伤地捶胸。

items.en: Plangere widened to any loud grieving.
items.cn: plangere 扩展到任何出声的悲悼。

items.en: Old French complainte named the lament itself.
items.cn: 古法语 complainte 指哀叹这件事本身。

items.en: English complaint first meant a lament for a loss.
items.cn: 英语 complaint 最初指为损失而哀叹。

items.en: It came to mean a grumble, a formal case and a bodily illness.
items.cn: 后来它指抱怨、正式案件以及身体的不适。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words one step from complaint, and the meaning group separates a grievance, an objection and an illness.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 complaint 只差一步的词，近义组分辨不满申诉、异议与疾病。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a full suggestion box, then move to an official case and to a sickness that has a name.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从塞满的意见箱开始，再走到正式的案子以及有了名字的病。

normal.en: Complaint is what is left after someone has complained.
normal.cn: complaint 就是有人抱怨过之后留下来的东西。

normal.en: Make a complaint, file a complaint, lodge a complaint: all three are common.
normal.cn: 提出、提交、正式递交投诉，三种说法都常见。

normal.en: A minor complaint at the doctor is a small illness.
normal.cn: 在医生那里说的小 complaint，就是小毛病。

normal.en: The spelling changes from complain to complaint; keep the t.
normal.cn: 从 complain 变 complaint 时要留住结尾的 t。

normal.en: A complaint is a complaint whether it is spoken, written or felt in the body.
normal.cn: 无论说出口、写下来还是落在身体里，它都是 complaint。

abstract.en: Picture a card box so full that the lid will not shut.
abstract.cn: 想象意见卡多到盒盖合不上。

abstract.en: Picture a form with a room number written in the corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一张表格，角上写着房间号。

abstract.en: Picture a patient listing symptoms one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象病人一条条说出症状。

examples.en: The manager listened to every complaint politely.
examples.cn: 经理礼貌地听完每一条投诉。

examples.en: He made a complaint about the broken seat.
examples.cn: 他就坏掉的座位提出了投诉。

examples.en: Her only complaint was a mild cough.
examples.cn: 她唯一的不适是轻微的咳嗽。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 complaint 记成 complain（抱怨）加 t：抱怨说出口，变成一件事，就是投诉。

sensesIntro.en: From a voiced grumble, to an official case, and finally to an illness of the body.
sensesIntro.cn: 从说出口的嘟囔，到正式的案子，最后到身体的不适。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a complaint card crammed into a small hotel letterbox.
core.cn: 核心意象：信箱里塞着一张写满字的意见卡。

branches.en: The spoken grumble is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 说出口的嘟囔是日常义项。

branches.en: Written and filed, the grumble becomes a case.
branches.cn: 写下来归档，嘟囔就成了一桩案子。

branches.en: The body also makes complaints, and doctors name them.
branches.cn: 身体也会抱怨，医生给它们命名。

branches.en: Both are words pointed at something wrong.
branches.cn: 两者都是指向某个问题的言语。

definition_en: to finish making something whole, or having every part and nothing missing
core_image: 最后一块拼图落位，整幅画终于没有缺口
scene: 木匠把最后一块板钉上，柜子刚好合缝。It took him a month to complete the cabinet.
sceneCN: 这里 complete 指「完成」（第 1 个义项：做完某事）；句意是他花了一个月才把柜子做完。

senses.title: To finish
senses.definition: to finish doing or making something
senses.definitionCN: 做完或制成某物
senses.example: She completed the report before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 她中午前完成了报告。
senses.why: The verb looks at the last step that closes a gap.
senses.whyCN: 动词着眼于补上缺口的那最后一步。

senses.title: Whole, with nothing missing
senses.definition: having every part and no gaps
senses.definitionCN: 各部分齐全、没有缺漏
senses.example: The museum owns a complete set of these coins.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆藏有这套钱币的完整一套。
senses.why: The adjective describes the state the last step leaves behind.
senses.whyCN: 形容词描述最后一步留下的状态。

senses.title: Total and thorough
senses.definition: used to stress that something is total
senses.definitionCN: 用来强调某事是彻底的
senses.example: The plan was a complete failure.

intro.en: Complete comes from Latin complere, to fill up, from com, completely, and plere, to fill.
intro.cn: complete 来自拉丁语 complere，意为填满，由 com（完全）与 plere（填充）构成。

items.en: Plere meant to fill something up.
items.cn: plere 意为把某物填满。

items.en: Complere meant to fill until nothing was missing.
items.cn: complere 意为填到一点不缺。

items.en: Completus described a thing fully filled.
items.cn: completus 描述被完全填满的事物。

items.en: Old French complet kept the sense of whole.
items.cn: 古法语 complet 保留了「完整」的意思。

items.en: English complete grew both a verb and an adjective use.

note.en: The look-alike group holds words one letter from complete, and the meaning group separates finishing, wholeness and total degree.

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with the last puzzle piece, then move to the whole it leaves and to the total degree it can name.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从最后一块拼图开始，再走到它留下的整体以及它能表示的彻底程度。

normal.en: Com- means fully and plere means fill, so complete is filled to the top.
normal.cn: com- 表示完全，plere 表示填满，complete 就是填到顶。

normal.en: As a verb, complete means to close the last gap.
normal.cn: 作动词时，complete 意为补上最后的缺口。

normal.en: As an adjective, complete means no part is missing.
normal.cn: 作形容词时，complete 意为没有一部分缺失。

normal.en: A complete failure is not a finished one, but a total one.
normal.cn: a complete failure 不是「完成了的失败」，而是「彻底的失败」。

normal.en: The noun is completion, and the opposite adjective is incomplete.
normal.cn: 名词是 completion，反面形容词是 incomplete。

root: 源自拉丁语 complere，com- 表示全部，plere 表示填满，本义是填满、使无空缺，后引申为完成、完整的与彻底的。

sensesIntro.en: From the last step that fills a gap, to the whole that results, and finally to total degree.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the last piece clicks in and the picture has no empty space.

branches.en: The verb names the act of closing the gap.
branches.cn: 动词指补上缺口的那个动作。

branches.en: The adjective names the whole that no longer has a gap.
branches.cn: 形容词指不再有缺口的整体。

branches.en: If nothing is missing, the degree can also be called complete.

branches.en: The act and the state are two sides of one filling.
branches.cn: 动作与状态是同一次填充的两面。

branches.en: A whole thing can also be wholly one way.
branches.cn: 一个完整的东西，也可以在程度上完全是某种样子。

intro.en: Complete is built on Latin com, fully, plus plere, to fill.

senses.title: To the greatest degree

senses.title: With nothing left out

senses.why: Here the stress falls on coverage: every part is touched.
senses.whyCN: 这里强调的是覆盖：每一部分都被涉及。

intro.en: Completely is the adverb of complete, from Latin complere, to fill up.
intro.cn: completely 是 complete 的副词形式，后者来自拉丁语 complere，意为填满。

items.en: Plere meant to fill, and complere meant to fill fully.
items.cn: plere 意为填充，complere 意为填满。

items.en: Completus described something with nothing missing.
items.cn: completus 描述毫无缺失的事物。

items.en: Old French complet passed the adjective into English.
items.cn: 古法语 complet 把这个形容词传进英语。

items.en: English added -ly to make the adverb of manner.
items.cn: 英语加上 -ly，构成表示方式的副词。

items.en: Completely became one of the commonest intensifiers.
items.cn: completely 成了最常用的强调词之一。

note.en: The look-alike group holds forms of the same complete family, and the meaning group ranks entirely, totally and fully.
note.cn: 形近组收的是 complete 家族的形式，近义组排出 entirely、totally 与 fully 的强弱。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with an emptied cup, then move to the strongest degree and to coverage with no gaps.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从倒空的杯子开始，再走到最强程度与毫无缺漏的覆盖。

normal.en: Complete means filled, and -ly turns it into filled to the last drop.
normal.cn: complete 是填满，加 -ly 就是填到最后一滴。

normal.en: Completely different means no part is the same.
normal.cn: completely different 指没有一处相同。

normal.en: Completely free is not partly free.
normal.cn: completely free 不是部分免费。

normal.en: Not completely sure is a polite way to doubt.
normal.cn: not completely sure 是礼貌地表示怀疑。

normal.en: The adverb almost always sits before the word it pushes.
normal.cn: 这个副词几乎总放在它所推动的词前面。

abstract.en: Picture a cup turned over and shaken, not a drop falling.
abstract.cn: 想象杯子倒过来抖一抖，一滴也不落。

abstract.en: Picture a room with every window shut and no sound at all.
abstract.cn: 想象房间每扇窗都关着，没有一点声音。

abstract.en: Picture a wall repainted from corner to corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一面墙从一角到另一角重新刷过。

examples.en: The two sisters are completely different in temper.
examples.cn: 这两姐妹的性情完全不同。

examples.en: He completely forgot the appointment.
examples.cn: 他把约会忘得一干二净。

examples.en: The tunnel was completely dark for a minute.
examples.cn: 隧道里有一分钟漆黑一片。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 completely 记成 complete（完整的）加 ly：做到一点不缺，就是完全地。

root: 由 complete（完整的）加副词后缀 -ly 构成，本义是以毫无缺漏的方式，后引申为完全地、彻底地。

sensesIntro.en: From the strongest degree, to full coverage with nothing missing.
sensesIntro.cn: 从最强的程度，到毫无遗漏的覆盖。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an emptied cup held upside down, not a drop left.
core.cn: 核心意象：杯子被倒空，倒过来连一滴也不剩。

branches.en: The first sense intensifies a feeling or a judgement.
branches.cn: 第一个义项把感受或判断推到最强。

branches.en: The second sense covers every part of a thing.
branches.cn: 第二个义项覆盖一件事的每一部分。

branches.en: Both come from the same image of a cup filled to the top.
branches.cn: 两者都来自同一个杯子被填满的意象。

branches.en: In speech it often softens a strong claim, as in not completely sure.
branches.cn: 在口语里它常让强硬的判断变软，比如 not completely sure。

branches.en: Rebuilding a house completely means touching every wall.
branches.cn: 把房子彻底重建，意味着每一面墙都动过。

latinIntro.en: The Latin filling base plere is still visible under the English word.

definition_en: made of many connected parts that are hard to understand, or a group of buildings, or a strong feeling fixed in the mind
core_image: 一团缠在一起的线，越拉越紧
scene: 新小区里有住宅、商铺和一所小学，走进去容易迷路。The new complex includes homes, shops and a school.
sceneCN: 这里 complex 指「综合体」（第 2 个义项：由多部分组成的建筑群）；句意是这个新综合体包含住宅、商铺和一所小学。

senses.title: Hard to understand
senses.definition: having many parts that are connected in ways hard to follow
senses.definitionCN: 由许多部分以难以理清的方式相连
senses.example: The tax rules are far too complex for most people.
senses.exampleCN: 税法对大多数人来说太复杂了。
senses.why: Many parts plus many links is exactly what makes a thing hard to hold in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 部分多、牵连多，正是事物难以在脑中把握的原因。

senses.title: A group of buildings
senses.definition: a group of buildings or facilities used for one purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为同一用途建起的一组建筑或设施
senses.example: The sports complex has two pools and a gym.
senses.exampleCN: 这个体育中心有两个泳池和一间健身房。
senses.why: Parts gathered on one site become a whole that carries one name.
senses.whyCN: 聚集在同一场地上的部分，成了一个共用一个名字的整体。

senses.title: A fixed feeling
senses.definition: a strong feeling or idea that is fixed in a person's mind
senses.definitionCN: 牢牢盘踞在人心里的强烈感受或念头
senses.example: He still has a complex about his accent.
senses.exampleCN: 他对自己的口音仍有心结。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the word for feelings woven so tightly that they hold the mind.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借这个词，指缠绕得紧紧、抓住人心的感受。

intro.en: Complex comes from Latin complecti, to embrace or intertwine, whose participle is complexus.
intro.cn: complex 来自拉丁语 complecti，意为拥抱或交织，其分词形式是 complexus。

items.en: Plectere meant to weave or to twine.
items.cn: plectere 意为编织或缠绕。

items.en: Complecti meant to wrap around and hold together.
items.cn: complecti 意为缠绕包围、抱在一起。

items.en: Complexus described things woven into one.
items.cn: complexus 描述被织成一体的东西。

items.en: English complex first meant made of connected parts.
items.cn: 英语 complex 最初指由相互连接的部分组成。

items.en: It expanded to building groups and to fixed feelings.
items.cn: 后来它扩展到建筑群以及盘踞不去的感受。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close to complex in sound, and the meaning group ranks complicated, intricate and a network of parts.
note.cn: 形近组收的是读音与 complex 相近的词，近义组排出复杂难懂、错综复杂与相互连接的部分。

normal.en: Com- is together and plex means weave, so complex is woven together.

normal.en: Many parts plus many links equals complex.

normal.en: A sports complex is one site holding many facilities.
normal.cn: 体育综合体就是一块场地上装着许多设施。

normal.en: An inferiority complex is a knot that keeps pulling tight.
normal.cn: 自卑情结就是一个越拉越紧的结。

normal.en: Complex is the thing; complexity is the quality it has.
normal.cn: complex 是那个东西，complexity 是它具备的性质。

abstract.en: Picture a ball of thread where one pull tightens everything.
abstract.cn: 想象一团线，一拉反而更紧。

abstract.en: Picture one gate opening onto homes, shops and a school.
abstract.cn: 想象一道门后连着住宅、商铺和学校。

abstract.en: Picture a single thought that keeps returning at night.
abstract.cn: 想象一个念头，夜里总是回来。

examples.en: The human brain is a highly complex organ.
examples.cn: 人脑是一个极其复杂的器官。

examples.en: They built a new shopping complex near the station.
examples.cn: 他们在车站附近建了一个新的购物中心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 complex 记成 com（一起）加 plex（编织）：许多线一起编在一块，就是复杂的。

root: 源自拉丁语 complecti（缠绕、拥抱）与 complexus，本义是交织在一起的，后引申为复杂的、综合体与情结。

sensesIntro.en: From many tangled parts, to many buildings on one site, and finally to a knot in the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 从交织的许多部分，到同一场地上的一片建筑，最后到心里的一个结。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ball of thread tangled so tightly that pulling makes it worse.
core.cn: 核心意象：一团缠在一起的线，越拉越紧。

branches.en: Many parts and many links make the first sense.
branches.cn: 部分多、连接多，造出了第一个义项。

branches.en: Buildings gathered on one site carry the same name.
branches.cn: 聚在同一场地的建筑沿用同一个名字。

branches.en: A feeling woven that tightly becomes a complex.
branches.cn: 一种感受缠得那么紧，就成了情结。

branches.en: Both senses gather parts into one whole.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把部分聚成一个整体。

branches.en: A tangle in the world and a tangle in the mind share one image.
branches.cn: 世上的乱麻与心里的乱麻共用一个意象。

intro.en: Complex is built on Latin com, together, plus plectere, to weave.
intro.cn: complex 由拉丁语 com（一起）加 plectere（编织）构成。

latinIntro.en: The weaving base also appears in perplex, to weave someone into confusion.

items.meaning: more than one complex or complex feeling

items.exampleCN: 这座城市有三个体育中心。

items.example: The complexity of the rules surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 规则的复杂程度让我们吃惊。

items.example: She explained the complexities of the case.

definition_zh: 使复杂化；使难懂；使恶化
definition_en: to make something more difficult to understand or deal with

scene: 本来只是一件小事，他一解释反而添了乱。Do not complicate a simple apology with long excuses.

senses.title: Make harder to follow
senses.definition: to make something harder to understand by adding parts
senses.definitionCN: 通过增加内容让某事更难理解
senses.example: Extra rules only complicate the game.
senses.exampleCN: 多余的规则只会让游戏变复杂。
senses.why: Every added part becomes one more thing the mind must hold.
senses.whyCN: 每增加一部分，脑子就要多记住一样东西。

senses.title: Make a problem worse
senses.definition: to make a bad situation or illness more serious
senses.definitionCN: 使糟糕的处境或病情变得更严重
senses.example: Stress can complicate recovery from illness.
senses.exampleCN: 压力会让病后恢复变得更棘手。
senses.why: A second trouble arriving on top of the first multiplies the burden.
senses.whyCN: 第二个麻烦压在第一个之上，负担就成倍增加。

senses.title: Twist things together
senses.definition: to fold or twist things together so they are hard to separate
senses.definitionCN: 把东西折叠或缠绕在一起，难以分开
senses.example: The wires were complicated into a tight knot.
senses.exampleCN: 电线被缠成了一个紧结。
senses.why: The oldest sense is physical folding, and confusion is folding in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是物理上的折叠，而困惑就是脑子里的折叠。

intro.en: Complicate comes from Latin complicare, to fold together, and first described things twisted into one another.
intro.cn: complicate 来自拉丁语 complicare，意为折在一起，最初描述互相缠结的东西。

items.en: Complicare described folding several layers into one bundle.

items.cn: 英语 complicate 最初指使交织、使缠结。

items.en: It now means to make a matter harder to understand or to handle.
items.cn: 如今它指让事情更难理解或更难处理。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that share the shape of complicate, and the meaning group names other ways of making a matter hard.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 complicate 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他把事弄难的说法。

normal.cn: com- 是一起，plic- 是折叠，所以 complicate 就是把东西折到一起。

normal.en: A simple task plus one extra rule equals a complicated task.
normal.cn: 简单的任务加一条多余的规则，就变成复杂的任务。

normal.en: A knot is complicate made visible in a piece of string.
normal.cn: 一个结，就是 complicate 在一根绳子上的可见形态。

normal.en: When an illness is complicated, a second problem has joined the first.
normal.cn: 病情被 complicate 时，就是第二个问题加入了第一个。

normal.en: Keep the promise simple and you never need to complicate it.
normal.cn: 把承诺保持简单，就永远不必把它弄复杂。

abstract.en: Picture one straight road that keeps splitting into smaller paths.
abstract.cn: 想象一条直路不断分出更小的岔路。

abstract.en: Picture a ball of string pulled by two hands at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一团线被两只手同时拉扯。

abstract.en: Picture a short answer buried under pages of notes.
abstract.cn: 想象一个简短答案被成页的注释埋住。

examples.en: The new rules only complicate the process for everyone.
examples.cn: 新规则只是让每个人的流程都变复杂。

examples.en: Travel delays were complicated by heavy snow.
examples.cn: 旅途的延误因大雪而更加棘手。

examples.en: Please do not complicate matters with more forms.
examples.cn: 请不要再拿更多表格把事情弄复杂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 complicate 记成 com（一起）加 plic（折叠）：把好几层折到一起，事情就变复杂了。

root: 源自拉丁语 complicare（com 一起 + plicare 折叠），本义是把东西折在一起，后引申为使事情交织、难懂与恶化。

sensesIntro.en: From folded cloth, to a tangled knot, and finally to a problem that grows heavier.
sensesIntro.cn: 从折起的布，到缠成的结，最后到越压越重的问题。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one straight line folded again and again until it is a knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条直线被反复折叠，最后成了一个结。

branches.en: Adding parts is the everyday way to complicate a task.
branches.cn: 增加内容是把任务弄复杂的日常方式。

branches.en: A second trouble makes the first one heavier.
branches.cn: 第二个麻烦会让第一个更沉重。

branches.en: The physical knot is the oldest picture behind the word.
branches.cn: 物理上的结，是这个词最古老的画面。

branches.en: Both senses add a layer that did not need to be there.
branches.cn: 两个义项都添了一层本不必要的负担。

branches.en: A tangled knot and a worsened problem both resist easy undoing.
branches.cn: 缠死的结与恶化的难题都难以轻松解开。

intro.en: Complicate is built on Latin com-, together, plus the base plic-, to fold.
intro.cn: complicate 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与词基 plic-（折叠）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin fold base plic- also appears in complex and multiply.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的折叠词基 plic- 也出现在 complex 与 multiply 中。

items.meaning: to make something harder to follow
items.example: Long forms complicate the application.
items.exampleCN: 冗长的表格让申请变复杂。

items.example: The machine has a complicated design.
items.exampleCN: 这台机器的设计很复杂。

items.example: A complicating factor appeared late.
items.exampleCN: 晚些时候出现了一个使情况恶化的因素。

items.example: The surgery had one small complication.
items.exampleCN: 手术出现了一个小并发症。

items.example: The doctor watched for complications.
items.exampleCN: 医生留心观察并发症。

items.example: It was an uncomplicated birth.
items.exampleCN: 那是一次顺利的分娩。

items.example: The brain is a complex organ.
items.exampleCN: 大脑是一个复杂的器官。

items.example: The complexity of the law surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 法律的复杂性让我们吃惊。

definition_zh: 组成部分；部件；成分；要素；组成的
definition_en: one of the parts that together make a whole machine, system or idea
core_image: 一台拆开的收音机，桌上散着一颗颗零件
scene: 修车师傅把拆下的零件按顺序摆在布上。Each component must go back in its exact place.
sceneCN: 这里 component 指「组成部分」（第 1 个义项：构成整体的部件）；句意是每个零件都必须装回它原来的确切位置。

senses.title: A part of a machine
senses.definition: one of several parts that make up a machine or device
senses.definitionCN: 组成机器或装置的若干部分之一
senses.example: The factory makes engine components.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂生产发动机部件。
senses.why: A machine can be taken apart into pieces, and each piece keeps a clear job.
senses.whyCN: 机器可以拆成零件，而每个零件都有明确的职责。

senses.title: An element of a whole
senses.definition: one part of a larger system, plan or idea
senses.definitionCN: 更大系统、计划或想法中的一部分
senses.example: Trust is a key component of teamwork.
senses.exampleCN: 信任是团队合作的关键要素。
senses.why: Not every part is metal; a system can be held together by an idea.
senses.whyCN: 并非每个部分都是金属做的；一个系统也能靠理念维系。

senses.title: Serving as one part
senses.definition: used to describe a part that helps to form a whole
senses.definitionCN: 用来描述有助于构成整体的部分
senses.example: The component parts are listed on the box.
senses.exampleCN: 各个组成部件都列在盒子上。
senses.why: The adjective simply turns the noun into a label for the part itself.
senses.whyCN: 形容词用法只是把这个名词变成对部件本身的标注。

intro.en: Component comes from Latin componere, to put together, and names a part that has been placed into a whole.
intro.cn: component 来自拉丁语 componere，意为放在一起，指被放进整体里的一个部分。

items.en: Componere joined com-, together, with ponere, to put.
items.cn: componere 由 com-（一起）与 ponere（放置）组合而成。

items.en: A componens was a part that entered a larger whole.
items.cn: componens 指进入更大整体的一个部分。

items.en: French composant named an element that enters a mixture.
items.cn: 法语 composant 指进入混合物的一个成分。

items.en: English component first described one part of a machine.
items.cn: 英语 component 最初指机器的一个部件。

items.en: It now covers parts of machines, systems and ideas alike.
items.cn: 如今它同样覆盖机器、系统与想法的组成部分。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that echo the ending of component, and the meaning group names other words for a part of a whole.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 component 词尾相近的词，近义组列出其他表示整体的部分的词。

entries.definition: a person who competes against you
a person who argues in favour of something
a thing made of two or more parts
a piece of a whole
one basic part of something larger
a single thing that forms part of a whole

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a machine laid out on a table, then move to systems and to the adjective label.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从摊在桌上的机器开始，再走到系统与形容词用法。

normal.en: Com- is together and pon- is put, so a component is something put in with the rest.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，pon- 是放置，component 就是和其他部分放在一起的东西。

normal.en: Take the radio apart and every component still looks useful.
normal.cn: 把收音机拆开，每个零件看起来仍然有用。

normal.en: A team has components too, and trust is one of them.
normal.cn: 团队也有组成部分，信任就是其中之一。

normal.en: Component parts is the phrase you see on the side of a box.
normal.cn: 盒子上写的那句话就是 component parts。

normal.en: One component can break the whole machine if it fails.
normal.cn: 一个部件出问题，就可能让整台机器停摆。

abstract.en: Picture a clock face opened to show its tiny wheels.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟被打开，露出里面细小的齿轮。

abstract.en: Picture a recipe where each ingredient does one job.
abstract.cn: 想象一份食谱，每种材料各司其职。

abstract.en: Picture one brick missing from a long wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一面长墙上缺了一块砖。

examples.en: Each component was tested before assembly.
examples.cn: 每个部件在装配前都经过测试。

examples.en: Cost is only one component of the decision.
examples.cn: 成本只是这个决定的一个组成部分。

examples.en: The component parts arrived in separate boxes.
examples.cn: 各个组成部件分装在几个盒子里运到。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 component 记成 com（一起）加 pon（放）加 ent：被一起放进整体里的那一块，就是部件。

root: 源自拉丁语 componere（com 一起 + ponere 放置），本义是被放入整体的部分，后指部件、成分与要素。

sensesIntro.en: From a metal part in a machine, to an element of a plan, and finally to the adjective that labels the part.
sensesIntro.cn: 从机器里的金属件，到计划中的要素，最后到标注部件的形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a radio taken apart on a table, every part in its own place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一台收音机被拆在桌上，每个零件各占一处。

branches.en: The machine sense is the most physical and the easiest to picture.
branches.cn: 机器义项最具体，也最容易想象。

branches.en: A plan or a team can also be built from parts.
branches.cn: 计划和团队同样可以由部分组成。

branches.en: The adjective simply labels a part as belonging to a whole.
branches.cn: 形容词用法只是标注某部分属于整体。

branches.en: Hardware and ideas are both assembled from smaller pieces.
branches.cn: 硬件和理念都由更小的部分组装而成。

branches.en: Component parts is the same idea used as a description.
branches.cn: component parts 只是把同一个意思用作描述。

intro.en: Component is built on Latin com-, together, plus ponere, to put, with the ending -ent.
intro.cn: component 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、ponere（放置）与词尾 -ent 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base pon- also gives compose, position and deposit.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 pon- 还给出 compose、position 与 deposit 这些词。

items.example: The kit contains fifty components.
items.exampleCN: 这套工具包含五十个部件。

items.example: The factory supplies electronic componentry.
items.exampleCN: 这家工厂供应电子零部件。

items.example: The study uses a componential analysis.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究采用成分分析法。

items.example: The two systems differ componentially.
items.exampleCN: 这两个系统在成分上有所不同。

items.example: Ten members compose the committee.
items.exampleCN: 十名成员组成这个委员会。

items.example: The composer revised the ending.
items.exampleCN: 作曲家修改了结尾。

items.meaning: the way parts are put together
items.example: The composition of the soil matters.
items.exampleCN: 土壤的构成很重要。

items.example: The bridge uses a composite material.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥使用一种复合材料。

definition_zh: 全面的；综合的；广泛的；综合中学
definition_en: including everything that is needed or relevant
core_image: 一张摊满整张桌面的大地图，把每条小路都画上
scene: 报告把每个环节都列了进去，一页也没漏。The report gives a comprehensive review of the whole project.
sceneCN: 这里 comprehensive 指「全面的」（第 1 个义项：涵盖所有部分）；句意是这份报告对整个项目做了全面回顾。

senses.title: Covering every part
senses.definition: including all or nearly all the parts of something
senses.definitionCN: 包含某事物的全部或几乎全部部分
senses.example: The book offers a comprehensive guide to the city.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书提供了一份全面的城市指南。
senses.why: A guide is called comprehensive when nothing important has been left out.
senses.whyCN: 当重要内容一样也没漏时，指南才被称为全面的。

senses.title: Wide in scope
senses.definition: broad enough to include many different things
senses.definitionCN: 范围足够广，能包含许多不同事物
senses.example: The law had a comprehensive effect on trade.
senses.exampleCN: 这项法律对贸易产生了广泛影响。
senses.why: Scope is breadth rather than depth, and comprehensive words stretch wide.
senses.whyCN: 范围讲的是广度而非深度，comprehensive 正是向四周铺开。

senses.title: A school for all abilities
senses.definition: in Britain, a secondary school for pupils of all abilities
senses.definitionCN: 在英国，招收各种能力学生的中学
senses.example: She went to the local comprehensive.
senses.exampleCN: 她上了当地的综合中学。
senses.why: The school takes in every kind of pupil, so it is comprehensive in people too.
senses.whyCN: 这所学校接纳各种学生，所以在人的意义上也是全面的。

intro.en: Comprehensive comes from Latin comprehendere, to seize or grasp, and first meant having the power to grasp everything.
intro.cn: comprehensive 来自拉丁语 comprehendere（抓住），最初指有能力把一切都抓住。

items.en: Comprehendere meant to seize or to take in completely.
items.cn: comprehendere 意为抓住或完整地纳入。

items.en: Comprehensivus described something that could take in all.
items.cn: comprehensivus 描述能纳入一切的东西。

items.en: French compréhensif kept the idea of wide grasp.
items.cn: 法语 compréhensif 保留了广泛把握的意思。

items.en: English comprehensive first meant including much in a small space.
items.cn: 英语 comprehensive 最初指在小篇幅内包含很多内容。

items.en: It grew to describe reports, insurance and schools.
items.cn: 后来它扩展到描述报告、保险与学校。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words sharing the shape of comprehensive, and the meaning group names other words for covering a whole.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 comprehensive 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示覆盖整体的词。

entries.definition: easy to understand
the ability to understand
in a complete and thorough way
having every necessary part
done with great care and in full
wide in range and effect

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a map that fills the whole table, then move to reports and to a school open to all.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一张铺满整桌的地图开始，再走到报告与向所有人开放的学校。

normal.en: Comprehend is to grasp, so comprehensive means able to grasp everything.
normal.cn: comprehend 是抓住，所以 comprehensive 就是能把一切抓住。

normal.en: A comprehensive review checks every room, not just the hall.
normal.cn: 全面的回顾会检查每个房间，而不只是大厅。

normal.en: Comprehensive insurance covers many kinds of damage at once.
normal.cn: 综合保险一次覆盖许多种损失。

normal.en: A comprehensive school takes pupils of every ability.
normal.cn: 综合中学招收各种能力的学生。

normal.en: Comprehensive and comprehensible differ: one covers all, one is easy to grasp.
normal.cn: comprehensive 与 comprehensible 不同：一个覆盖全部，一个容易理解。

abstract.en: Picture a map so large that no road is missing.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图大得没有一条路被漏掉。

abstract.en: Picture a checklist with every box already ticked.
abstract.cn: 想象一张清单，每个格子都已打勾。

abstract.en: Picture one net thrown over an entire field.
abstract.cn: 想象一张网罩住整片田野。

examples.en: The committee ordered a comprehensive review of the budget.
examples.cn: 委员会要求对预算进行全面审查。

examples.en: This dictionary aims to be comprehensive.
examples.cn: 这部词典力求全面。

examples.en: He attended a comprehensive in the north of the city.
examples.cn: 他在城北的一所综合中学就读。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comprehensive 记成 com（一起）加 prehend（抓住）：把所有部分一起抓住，就是全面的。

root: 源自拉丁语 comprehendere（com 一起 + prehendere 抓住），本义是全部抓住，后引申为全面的、广泛的，并指招收各类学生的综合中学。

sensesIntro.en: From all parts of a thing, to a wide reach, and finally to a school that takes in every kind of pupil.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一件事的所有部分，到宽广的范围，最后到接纳各类学生的学校。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a map spread over the whole table, with every small road drawn in.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张铺满整桌的地图，连每条小路都画上了。

branches.en: Completeness of parts is the central sense.
branches.cn: 部分的完整是核心义项。

branches.en: Width of range is completeness stretched sideways.
branches.cn: 范围的宽广，是完整性向两侧铺开。

branches.en: A school becomes comprehensive by including all pupils.
branches.cn: 学校因接纳所有学生而变得 comprehensive。

branches.en: Both senses answer the question of what has been left out.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在回答漏掉了什么。

branches.en: A full report and a full school both refuse to exclude.
branches.cn: 完整的报告与完整的学校都拒绝排除。

intro.en: Comprehensive is built on Latin com-, together, plus prehendere, to seize, with the adjective ending -ive.
intro.cn: comprehensive 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、prehendere（抓住）与形容词词尾 -ive 构成。

latinIntro.en: The same base gives comprehension, comprehend and comprehensible.
latinIntro.cn: 同一个词基还给出 comprehension、comprehend 与 comprehensible。

items.example: They wrote a comprehensive plan.
items.exampleCN: 他们写了一份全面的计划。

items.example: The team reviewed the data comprehensively.
items.exampleCN: 团队全面地审查了数据。

items.example: The comprehensiveness of the index impressed us.
items.exampleCN: 索引的全面性让我们印象深刻。

items.example: Few could comprehend the scale of the loss.
items.exampleCN: 很少有人能理解损失之大。

items.example: Comprehension comes before memory.
items.exampleCN: 理解先于记忆。

items.example: Her answer was short and comprehensible.
items.exampleCN: 她的回答简短而清楚。

items.example: The noise was incomprehensible.
items.exampleCN: 那声音无法理解。

items.example: Editors check the comprehensibility of each page.
items.exampleCN: 编辑检查每一页的可理解性。

definition_en: to consist of particular parts, or to form a particular whole
core_image: 一只篮子里装着七种不同的水果，篮子本身不算在内
scene: 这支队伍由五名老队员和三名新人组成。The team comprises five veterans and three newcomers.
sceneCN: 这里 comprise 指「由…组成」（第 1 个义项：整体包含所列的部分）；句意是这支队伍由五名老队员和三名新人组成。

senses.title: Consist of parts
senses.definition: to be made up of the parts that are mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 由所提到的部分构成
senses.example: The course comprises six modules.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程由六个模块组成。
senses.why: The whole stands first, and the parts are listed as its contents.
senses.whyCN: 整体先站在那里，部分则作为它的内容被列出。

senses.title: Form a whole together
senses.definition: to combine to form a particular whole
senses.definitionCN: 结合起来构成某个整体
senses.example: These six states comprise the region.
senses.exampleCN: 这六个州构成这个地区。
senses.why: Look from the other side and the parts are the builders of the whole.
senses.whyCN: 从另一面看，部分就是整体的建造者。

intro.en: Comprise comes from French comprendre, to include, and its past participle compris, meaning included.
intro.cn: comprise 来自法语 comprendre（包括），其过去分词 compris 意为被包括在内。

items.en: Comprehendere meant to seize or to take in.
items.cn: comprehendere 意为抓住或纳入。

items.en: Old French comprendre meant to contain or to include.
items.cn: 古法语 comprendre 意为包含或包括。

items.en: The past participle compris meant included in a whole.
items.cn: 过去分词 compris 意为被包括在整体中。

items.en: English comprise first meant to lay hold of or to include.
items.cn: 英语 comprise 最初指握住或包括。

items.en: It settled into the two opposite-looking patterns of whole and parts.
items.cn: 它最终固定为整体与部分两种看似相反的用法。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to comprise, and the meaning group names other words for containing parts.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 comprise 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示包含部分的词。

entries.definition: to form a whole from parts
an agreement in which each side gives up something
an unexpected event or feeling
to have something as one of its parts
to have something inside
to include something as part of a whole

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a basket full of fruit, then look at the same basket from the fruit's side.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从装满水果的篮子开始，再从水果那一侧看同一只篮子。

normal.en: Com- is together and prise comes from prendre, to take, so comprise is to take things together.
normal.cn: com- 是一起，prise 源自 prendre（拿取），comprise 就是把东西一起收进来。

normal.en: A team comprises its members; the members compose the team.
normal.cn: 队伍 comprise 队员，而队员 compose 队伍。

normal.en: Do not say is comprised by; use is composed of instead.
normal.cn: 不要说 is comprised by，而用 is composed of 更稳妥。

normal.en: The whole comprises the parts, never the other way round.
normal.cn: 整体 comprise 部分，而不是反过来。

normal.en: A region comprises its states, and the states make up the region.
normal.cn: 地区 comprise 各州，而各州构成了地区。

abstract.en: Picture a basket holding seven different fruits.
abstract.cn: 想象一只篮子装着七种不同的水果。

abstract.en: Picture a single box with every item listed on its side.
abstract.cn: 想象一只箱子，侧面列着里面每样东西。

abstract.en: Picture a circle drawn around several separate dots.
abstract.cn: 想象一个圆圈把几个分开的点圈在一起。

examples.en: The committee comprises twelve members.
examples.cn: 委员会由十二名成员组成。

examples.en: These four counties comprise the whole province.
examples.cn: 这四个县构成整个省。

examples.en: The price comprises room and breakfast.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spotlight pouring all its light onto a single point.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏聚光灯把光全部打在一个点上。

branches.en: Attention is the everyday sense most learners meet first.
branches.cn: 注意力是学习者最先遇到的日常义项。

branches.en: A crowd or a cluster of factories shows the gathering sense.
branches.cn: 人群或工厂群体现了聚集义项。

branches.en: Chemistry measures how much is packed into a space.
branches.cn: 化学衡量的是一个空间里装了多少。

branches.en: Mind and crowd both become stronger at one point.
branches.cn: 心思与人群都在一个点上变得更强。

branches.en: Gathering things and packing a liquid follow one pattern.
branches.cn: 聚拢东西与装浓液体遵循同一种模式。

intro.en: Concentration is built on Latin com-, together, plus centrum, centre, with the noun ending -ation.
intro.cn: concentration 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、centrum（中心）与名词词尾 -ation 构成。

latinIntro.en: The centre base centr- also gives central, eccentric and centrifugal.
latinIntro.cn: 中心词基 centr- 还给出 central、eccentric 与 centrifugal。

items.example: The samples showed different concentrations.
items.exampleCN: 样本显示出不同的浓度。

items.example: Please concentrate on the question.
items.exampleCN: 请把注意力放在问题上。

items.example: The syrup is very concentrated.
items.exampleCN: 这种糖浆很浓。

items.example: She sat concentrating for an hour.
items.exampleCN: 她坐着专注了一个小时。

items.example: Silence has a concentrative power.
items.exampleCN: 安静有让人专注的力量。

items.example: The concentrator runs all night.
items.exampleCN: 浓缩器整夜运转。

items.example: The target has concentric circles.
items.exampleCN: 靶子上有同心圆。

items.example: The older text uses concentrical rings.
items.exampleCN: 较早的文本用 concentrical 表示同心环。

definition_en: an idea or a general notion of something
core_image: 空中飘着一条细细的线，把许多例子串成一个小结
scene: 老师用几个圆圈画出「公平」这个概念。The children drew pictures to show the concept of fairness.
sceneCN: 这里 concept 指「概念」（第 1 个义项：对事物的一般想法）；句意是孩子们用图画来表现公平这个概念。

senses.title: A general idea
senses.definition: an idea of what something is or how it works
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物是什么或如何运作的想法
senses.example: The concept of time varies across cultures.
senses.exampleCN: 时间的概念在不同文化中有所不同。
senses.why: A concept gathers many examples under one name in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 概念在脑中把许多例子收在同一个名字下。

senses.title: A plan or design
senses.definition: an idea for a new product, plan or work
senses.definitionCN: 对新产品、计划或作品的设想
senses.example: The concept car was shown at the fair.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆概念车在展会上亮相。
senses.why: Before a thing exists, it exists as a picture in someone's mind.
senses.whyCN: 在事物存在之前，它先作为脑海中的画面存在。

intro.en: Concept comes from Latin conceptum, a thing conceived, from concipere, to take in or to conceive.
intro.cn: concept 来自拉丁语 conceptum（被孕育之物），源自动词 concipere（纳入、孕育）。

items.en: Concipere joined com-, together, with capere, to take.
items.cn: concipere 由 com-（一起）与 capere（拿取）组合而成。

items.en: Conceptum named something taken into the mind.
items.cn: conceptum 指被收入心智的东西。

items.en: Conceptus described a thought formed inside a person.
items.cn: conceptus 描述在人内部形成的想法。

items.en: English concept named a general idea held in the mind.
items.cn: 英语 concept 指脑中持有的一般想法。

items.en: It now also names the first design of a product.
items.cn: 如今它也指产品最初的设想设计。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concept, and the meaning group names other words for an idea in the mind.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concept 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示脑中想法的词。

entries.definition: the forming of an idea in the mind
a paper showing that you have paid
too much pride in yourself
a thought or suggestion about something
a belief or idea, often vague
an idea used to explain something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with many examples tied into one knot, then move to a car that exists only as a drawing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从许多例子被系成一个结开始，再走到只以图纸存在的汽车。

normal.en: Con- is together and cept is to take, so a concept is what the mind takes in together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cept 是拿取，concept 就是心智一起收进来的东西。

normal.en: A concept is a box in the mind that holds many examples.
normal.cn: 概念是脑中的一只盒子，装着许多例子。

normal.en: Concept is the thing; conception is the act of forming it.
normal.cn: concept 是那个东西，conception 是形成它的动作。

normal.en: A concept car is a car that lives in the mind before the road.
normal.cn: 概念车是先活在脑中、后上路的汽车。

normal.en: Abstract concepts have no shape, so we borrow pictures for them.
normal.cn: 抽象概念没有形状，所以我们借图画来表现它们。

abstract.en: Picture many scattered dots joined by one thin line.
abstract.cn: 想象许多散点被一条细线连起来。

abstract.en: Picture a light bulb above a sketched machine.
abstract.cn: 想象一台草图机器上方亮起一只灯泡。

abstract.en: Picture a label that fits a whole shelf of jars.
abstract.cn: 想象一张标签适合整架罐子。

examples.en: Children learn the concept of number before they write figures.
examples.cn: 孩子在写数字之前先学会数的概念。

examples.en: The designer explained her concept for the new library.
examples.cn: 设计师讲解了她对新图书馆的构想。

examples.en: It is a simple concept but hard to apply.
examples.cn: 这是个简单的概念，却很难应用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concept 记成 con（一起）加 cept（拿取）：把许多例子一起收进脑子，就成了一个概念。

root: 源自拉丁语 concipere（com 一起 + capere 拿取）的过去分词 conceptum，本义是收入心智之物，后指概念与构想。

sensesIntro.en: From a general idea that gathers examples, to a design that exists before the object.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把例子收拢起来的一般想法，到先于实物存在的设计。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one thin line tying many scattered examples into a single knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条细线把许多散开的例子系成一个结。

branches.en: The general idea is the central and most common sense.
branches.cn: 一般想法是核心也最常见的义项。

branches.en: The design sense narrows the idea to a future product.
branches.cn: 设计义项把想法收窄到未来的产品。

branches.en: Philosophers study concepts as units of thought.
branches.cn: 哲学家把概念当作思维单位来研究。

branches.en: Companies show concept models before they sell anything.
branches.cn: 公司在销售之前先展示概念模型。

branches.en: Both senses are things held in the mind before they are things in the world.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是先存在于脑中、后存在于世上的东西。

intro.en: Concept is built on Latin com-, together, plus capere, to take, through the form conceptum.
intro.cn: concept 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 capere（拿取）构成，形式为 conceptum。

latinIntro.en: The Latin take base cap- also gives capture, accept and capacity.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的拿取词基 cap- 还给出 capture、accept 与 capacity。

items.example: The course introduces basic concepts.
items.exampleCN: 这门课介绍基本概念。

items.example: Her conception of duty is strict.
items.exampleCN: 她对责任的理解很严格。

items.example: The drawing is still conceptual.
items.exampleCN: 这张图仍停留在概念阶段。

items.example: The two plans are conceptually similar.
items.exampleCN: 这两个方案在概念上相似。

items.meaning: to form an idea of something
items.example: It is hard to conceptualize such a large number.
items.exampleCN: 很难构想这么大的数字。

items.example: The book offers a new conceptualization of space.
items.exampleCN: 这本书提供了对空间的新概念化。

items.example: He wrote about medieval conceptualism.
items.exampleCN: 他写过关于中世纪概念论的文章。

items.example: They misconceive the purpose of the rule.
items.exampleCN: 他们误解了这条规则的目的。

definition_zh: 担忧；关心；涉及；关系；公司
definition_en: a feeling of worry, or something that affects or involves you
core_image: 母亲站在校门口，目光一直追着孩子的背影
scene: 医生看着检查单，眉头慢慢皱了起来。The results concern me, so I want more tests.
sceneCN: 这里 concern 指「使担忧」（第 2 个义项：让人感到不安）；句意是这些结果让我担心，所以我想再做几项检查。

pos.zh: 担忧；关心；关切的事；公司

collocations.phrase: as far as I am concerned

senses.title: A feeling of worry
senses.definition: a feeling of worry about something important
senses.definitionCN: 对重要事物的担忧之情
senses.example: There is growing concern about air quality.
senses.exampleCN: 人们对空气质量的担忧与日俱增。
senses.why: When something matters, the mind keeps returning to it with unease.
senses.whyCN: 当某件事重要时，心就会带着不安一再回到它身上。

senses.title: To make someone worried
senses.definition: to make someone feel worried or anxious
senses.definitionCN: 使某人感到担心或不安
senses.example: The test results concern the doctor.
senses.exampleCN: 检查结果让医生担忧。
senses.why: A fact can reach out and trouble the person who learns it.
senses.whyCN: 一个事实能伸出去，扰动得知它的人。

senses.title: To be about or affect
senses.definition: to affect someone, or to be about a particular subject
senses.definitionCN: 影响某人，或关于某个主题
senses.example: This decision concerns every employee.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定涉及每一位员工。
senses.why: What touches you is what you must care about, so concern also means involvement.
senses.whyCN: 触动你的东西就是你必须在意的，所以 concern 也指关涉。

intro.en: Concern comes from Latin concernere, to sift together, from com-, together, and cernere, to sift or judge.
intro.cn: concern 来自拉丁语 concernere（一起筛），由 com-（一起）与 cernere（筛、判断）构成。

items.en: Cernere meant to sift, to separate or to judge.
items.cn: cernere 意为筛、分辨或判断。

items.en: Concernere meant to sift things together into one view.
items.cn: concernere 意为把东西筛到一起，纳入同一视野。

items.en: Old French concerner meant to relate to or to touch.
items.cn: 古法语 concerner 意为与…相关或触及。

items.en: English concern first meant to be relevant to something.
items.cn: 英语 concern 最初指与某事相关。

items.en: The sense of worry grew from things that are relevant and important.
items.cn: 担忧义从相关且重要的事情中生长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concern, and the meaning group names other words for worry and involvement.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concern 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示担忧与关涉的词。

entries.definition: a public performance of music
to notice something that is not obvious
about a particular subject
a feeling that something bad may happen
the feeling that something matters to you
a feeling of wanting to know more

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a parent watching a child, then move to a doctor reading results and to a rule that touches everyone.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从母亲望着孩子开始，再走到医生看检查单与涉及每个人的规定。

normal.en: Con- is together and cern is to sift, so concern is what your mind keeps sifting over.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cern 是筛，concern 就是心里反复筛检的那件事。

normal.en: Concern as a noun is the worry; concern as a verb is what causes it.
normal.cn: concern 作名词是担忧，作动词则是引起担忧的东西。

normal.en: As far as I am concerned means as far as this touches me.
normal.cn: 「as far as I am concerned」意为就触及我的范围而言。

normal.en: A going concern is a business that is still running.
normal.cn: a going concern 就是仍在运转的企业。

normal.en: Concerned parents ask questions; unconcerned ones do not.
normal.cn: 关心的父母会追问，漠不关心的则不会。

abstract.en: Picture a mother at the school gate watching one small back.
abstract.cn: 想象母亲在校门口望着一个小小的背影。

abstract.en: Picture a finger tracing a line of test results.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指沿着一行检查结果划过去。

abstract.en: Picture a circle drawn around everyone in a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个圆圈把屋里每个人都圈了进去。

examples.en: There is real concern about the rising cost of housing.
examples.cn: 人们对住房成本上涨确有担忧。

examples.en: Her health concerns the whole family.
examples.cn: 她的健康让全家担忧。

examples.en: The new rules concern every member of staff.
examples.cn: 新规定涉及每一位员工。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concern 记成 con（一起）加 cern（筛）：心里反复筛来筛去的那件事，就是担忧与关切。

root: 源自拉丁语 concernere（com 一起 + cernere 筛、判断），本义是把事物筛到一起加以分辨，后引申为涉及、关心与担忧。

sensesIntro.en: From something sifted into your view, to the worry it causes, and finally to the fact that it affects you.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被筛进你视野的事，到它引起的担忧，最后到它确实影响到你。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mother at the school gate, her eyes following one small figure.
core.cn: 核心意象：母亲站在校门口，目光追着一个小小的身影。

branches.en: The noun sense of worry is the most common in daily speech.
branches.cn: 名词的担忧义是日常口语中最常见的。

branches.en: The verb can point at the cause of worry rather than the feeling.
branches.cn: 动词可以指向担忧的起因，而非感受本身。

branches.en: Involvement is the oldest layer, still visible in concerning.
branches.cn: 关涉是最古老的一层，仍留在 concerning 里。

branches.en: Feeling and cause are two ends of one relation.
branches.cn: 感受与起因是同一关系两端。

branches.en: What touches you can worry you, and what worries you clearly touches you.
branches.cn: 触及你的事可能让你担忧，让你担忧的事必然触及你。

intro.en: Concern is built on Latin com-, together, plus cernere, to sift, through the French form concerner.
intro.cn: concern 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 cernere（筛）构成，经法语 concerner 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin sift base cern- also gives discern, certain and discriminate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的筛分词基 cern- 还给出 discern、certain 与 discriminate。

items.example: Parents raised several concerns.
items.exampleCN: 家长提出了几项担忧。

items.example: The concerned neighbours called the police.
items.exampleCN: 担心的邻居报了警。

items.example: She asked a question concerning safety.
items.exampleCN: 她问了一个关于安全的问题。

items.example: He looked at the meter concernedly.
items.exampleCN: 他担忧地看着仪表。

items.example: She seemed unconcerned by the delay.
items.exampleCN: 她似乎对延误毫不在意。

items.example: His unconcern surprised everyone.
items.exampleCN: 他的漠不关心让大家吃惊。

items.example: The concernment of the issue is clear.
items.exampleCN: 这个问题的重要性很清楚。

items.example: The concert raised money for the school.
items.exampleCN: 音乐会为学校筹款。

definition_zh: 音乐会；演奏会；一致；协作
definition_en: a public performance of music, or agreement between people acting together
core_image: 整个乐团在指挥抬手的一瞬同时吸气
scene: 大厅的灯暗下来，第一声小提琴响起。The concert began with a single note from the violin.
sceneCN: 这里 concert 指「音乐会」（第 1 个义项：公开的音乐演出）；句意是音乐会以小提琴的一个单音开始。

pos.zh: 音乐会；演奏会；一致；协作

senses.title: A music performance
senses.definition: a public performance of music given by one or more musicians
senses.definitionCN: 由一位或多位音乐家进行的公开音乐演出
senses.example: The concert lasted two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这场音乐会持续了两个小时。
senses.why: Many players must sound as one, so the event is named for their agreement.
senses.whyCN: 许多演奏者必须听起来像一个，所以这场活动以他们的和谐命名。

senses.title: Acting together
senses.definition: agreement or combined action between people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 人或团体之间的一致或联合行动
senses.example: The two groups acted in concert.
senses.exampleCN: 两个团体协同行动。
senses.why: The older sense is harmony, and harmony between people is also concert.
senses.whyCN: 更古老的意思是和谐，而人与人之间的和谐也是 concert。

intro.en: Concert comes from Italian concerto, agreement or harmony, and first named musicians playing as one.
intro.cn: concert 来自意大利语 concerto（一致、和谐），最初指乐手们如同一人地演奏。

items.en: Concertare meant to strive or to work together.
items.cn: concertare 意为共同努力或相互竞争。

items.en: Concerto named voices or instruments sounding in harmony.
items.cn: concerto 指人声或乐器和谐地响起。

items.en: A concerto also became a piece for soloist and orchestra.
items.cn: concerto 也成为一种独奏与乐队合作的作品。

items.en: French concert named a public musical gathering.
items.cn: 法语 concert 指公开的音乐聚会。

items.en: English concert took both the musical and the agreement senses.
items.cn: 英语 concert 同时接纳了音乐与一致两种含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concert, and the meaning group names other words for a musical show.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concert 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示音乐演出的词。

done together by several people
a small group of old instruments
an act of playing music for an audience
a small concert by one performer
a public entertainment event

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with an orchestra breathing together, then move to people acting as one.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从整个乐团一起吸气开始，再走到人们如同一人地行动。

normal.en: Con- is together and cert comes from a word for striving, so concert is many efforts made one.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cert 源自表示努力的古词，concert 就是许多努力合成一个。

normal.en: In a concert, a hundred players breathe at the same moment.
normal.cn: 在音乐会上，上百名演奏者会在同一瞬间吸气。

normal.en: In concert with means working in harmony with others.
normal.cn: in concert with 意为与他人和谐协作。

normal.en: A rock concert and a symphony concert share the same name.
normal.cn: 摇滚音乐会与交响音乐会共用同一个名字。

normal.en: Concerto and concert are cousins, both from the idea of harmony.
normal.cn: concerto 与 concert 是表亲，都来自和谐这个意思。

abstract.en: Picture a conductor's hand lifting a whole orchestra at once.
abstract.cn: 想象指挥的手一下把整个乐团提起来。

abstract.en: Picture many strings vibrating into one warm sound.
abstract.cn: 想象许多琴弦振动成一个温暖的声音。

abstract.en: Picture two teams rowing in the same rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象两支队伍按同一节奏划桨。

examples.en: We went to a concert in the park last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚我们去公园听了一场音乐会。

examples.en: The two countries acted in concert to protect the river.
examples.cn: 两国协作保护这条河。

examples.en: The concert hall was full an hour early.
examples.cn: 音乐厅提前一小时就坐满了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concert 记成 con（一起）加 cert（确定）：大家把声音确定在同一个调上，就是音乐会，也是一致协作。

root: 源自意大利语 concerto（一致、和谐），上溯拉丁语 concertare（共同努力），本义是声音和谐一致，后指音乐会与协同行动。

sensesIntro.en: From many instruments sounding as one, to many people acting as one.
sensesIntro.cn: 从许多乐器发出同一个声音，到许多人如同一人地行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole orchestra drawing breath together as the conductor lifts a hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：指挥抬手的一瞬，整个乐团一起吸气。

branches.en: The musical event is the everyday sense of concert.
branches.cn: 音乐活动是 concert 的日常义项。

branches.en: The agreement sense survives in the phrase in concert.
branches.cn: 一致义项保留在 in concert 这个短语中。

branches.en: A concert is public, so it gathers players and listeners.
branches.cn: 音乐会面向公众，因此聚起演奏者与听众。

branches.en: Joint action is harmony applied to work rather than music.
branches.cn: 联合行动是把和谐用于工作而非音乐。

branches.en: Both senses depend on many parts keeping one time.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖许多部分守住同一个节拍。

intro.en: Concert is built on Latin com-, together, plus certare, to strive, through the Italian form concerto.
intro.cn: concert 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 certare（努力）构成，经意大利语 concerto 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The striving base cert- also appears in certain and certify, where it means settled.

items.example: The band plays thirty concerts a year.

definition_zh: 断定；得出结论；结束；缔结
definition_en: to decide something after considering facts, or to bring something to an end
core_image: 一段长路走到尽头，回望时把整条路线看清
scene: 听完双方陈述，法官合上卷宗。The judge concluded that the evidence was weak.
sceneCN: 这里 conclude 指「断定」（第 1 个义项：根据事实作出判断）；句意是法官断定证据不足。

pos.zh: 断定；得出结论；结束；缔结

senses.title: Reach a judgment
senses.definition: to decide that something is true after thinking about the facts
senses.definitionCN: 在思考事实之后判定某事为真
senses.example: We concluded that the plan was too risky.
senses.exampleCN: 我们断定这个计划风险太大。
senses.why: When the evidence is all in, the mind shuts the case and settles.
senses.whyCN: 证据齐了，心就合上案卷，作出定论。

senses.title: Bring to an end
senses.definition: to finish an event, speech or piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 结束一个活动、演讲或文章
senses.example: The meeting concluded at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 会议在中午结束。
senses.why: To close a matter is the same motion as closing a door.
senses.whyCN: 关闭一件事，和关上一扇门是同一个动作。

senses.title: Arrange a formal agreement
senses.definition: to complete a treaty, deal or agreement formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式完成条约、交易或协议
senses.example: The two countries concluded a trade agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 两国缔结了一项贸易协定。
senses.why: A deal is closed like a box, and once shut it is binding.
senses.whyCN: 交易像箱子一样被合上，一旦合上便有约束力。

intro.en: Conclude comes from Latin concludere, to shut up together, from com-, together, and claudere, to close.
intro.cn: conclude 来自拉丁语 concludere（一起关上），由 com-（一起）与 claudere（关闭）构成。

items.en: Claudere meant to close or to shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭或合上。

items.en: Concludere meant to shut something in or to end it.
items.cn: concludere 意为把某物关起来或结束它。

items.en: Conclusio named a closing or a final inference.
items.cn: conclusio 指收尾或最终的推论。

items.en: Old French conclure meant to finish or to decide.
items.cn: 古法语 conclure 意为结束或决定。

items.en: English conclude took both the ending and the reasoning senses.
items.cn: 英语 conclude 同时接纳了结束与推理两种含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to conclude, and the meaning group names other words for deciding or ending.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 conclude 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示断定与结束的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a case file being closed, then move to a meeting ending and a treaty signed.

normal.en: Con- is together and clude is to close, so conclude is to close everything up.

normal.en: A judge concludes when the evidence has been shut into one story.

normal.en: A speech concludes with a last line, as a box closes with a lid.

examples.cn: 报告断定这座桥是安全的。

examples.en: She concluded her talk with a short story.
examples.cn: 她用一个短故事结束了演讲。

examples.en: The two firms concluded a deal last week.
examples.cn: 两家公司上周达成了一笔交易。

definition_en: a judgment reached after thinking, or the end of something

senses.title: A judgment reached
senses.definition: a decision or opinion formed after considering the facts

senses.exampleCN: 她的结论建立在确凿证据之上。

senses.title: The end of something

senses.exampleCN: 演讲的结尾很动人。

senses.title: A formal agreement

senses.example: The conclusion of the peace treaty was welcomed.
senses.exampleCN: 和平条约的缔结受到欢迎。
senses.why: A deal is brought to its close, and that close is named the conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 交易被带到终点，而那个终点就叫 conclusion。

definition_zh: 条件；状况；环境；使适应；护理
definition_en: something that must exist before something else can happen, or the state something is in
core_image: 一个人反复擦拭旧手表，让它保持准确的走时
scene: 二手车商把每辆车的状况写在小牌上。The condition of the tyres decides the price.
sceneCN: 这里 condition 指「状况」（第 2 个义项：人或物所处的状态）；句意是轮胎的状况决定价格。

senses.title: Something required first
senses.definition: a thing that must happen or exist before something else is possible
senses.definitionCN: 必须先发生或存在，其他事才可能实现的事
senses.example: Patience is a condition of good teaching.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是做好教学的一个条件。
senses.why: A door needs a key before it can open, and a result needs its condition.
senses.whyCN: 门要先有钥匙才能开，结果也要先有条件。

senses.title: The state of something
senses.definition: the physical state that a person or thing is in
senses.definitionCN: 人或物在身体或物理上的状态
senses.example: The car is still in good condition.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车状况仍然良好。
senses.why: You judge a thing by how well it still does its job.
senses.whyCN: 判断一件东西，就看它还能把本分做得多好。

senses.title: Train or care for
senses.definition: to train someone to react in a certain way, or to keep something healthy
senses.definitionCN: 训练某人形成某种反应，或使某物保持良好状态
senses.example: The animals were conditioned to accept people.
senses.exampleCN: 这些动物被训练得能接受人类。
senses.why: Repeated practice shapes a response, and repeated care keeps a thing fit.
senses.whyCN: 反复练习塑造反应，反复护理让东西保持良好。

intro.en: Condition comes from Latin condicio, an agreement or situation, from condicere, to talk something over together.
intro.cn: condition 来自拉丁语 condicio，意为约定或情形，源自动词 condicere（一起商谈）。

definition_en: the way a person behaves, or to organize an activity and carry it out
core_image: 乐队指挥举起双手，让整个乐团同时发声
scene: 老师带学生参观实验室，提醒大家注意行为举止。His conduct in the lab impressed every teacher.
sceneCN: 这里 conduct 指「行为举止」（第 1 个义项：一个人在公开场合的表现）；句意是他在实验室里的举止让每位老师都印象深刻。

senses.title: The way one behaves
senses.definition: the way a person acts, especially in public or at work
senses.definitionCN: 一个人行事的方式，尤指在公开场合或工作中的表现
senses.example: His conduct during the meeting was calm.
senses.exampleCN: 他在会议上的举止很沉稳。
senses.why: Others cannot see your motives, so they judge what you do.
senses.whyCN: 别人看不见你的动机，只能凭你的所做来判断。

senses.title: Carry out an activity
senses.definition: to organize and carry out a plan, test or study
senses.definitionCN: 组织并完成计划、测试或研究
senses.example: The team conducted a survey of local farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 团队对当地农民做了一次调查。
senses.why: An activity needs someone to lead it from start to finish.
senses.whyCN: 一项活动需要有人从头到尾带着走。

senses.title: Lead a group or carry energy
senses.definition: to direct a group such as an orchestra, or to carry heat or electricity
senses.definitionCN: 指挥乐团等团体，或输送热与电
senses.example: Copper conducts electricity very well.
senses.exampleCN: 铜的导电性非常好。
senses.why: A leader and a wire both carry something from one end to the other.
senses.whyCN: 领导者与电线都在把某样东西从一端送到另一端。

intro.en: Conduct comes from Latin conducere, to lead together, built from com-, together, and ducere, to lead.
intro.cn: conduct 来自拉丁语 conducere，意为一起带领，由 com-（一起）与 ducere（引导）构成。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead a person or an army along a road.
items.cn: ducere 意为带着人或军队沿路前行。

items.en: Conducere meant to bring several things together under one lead.
items.cn: conducere 意为把几件事物收拢到同一个带领之下。

items.en: Old French conduire used the word for guiding and managing.
items.cn: 古法语 conduire 用这个词表示引导与管理。

items.en: English conduct first named the act of leading or guiding.
items.cn: 英语 conduct 最初指带领与引导的行为。

items.en: It now covers behaviour as well as the carrying of heat and electricity.
items.cn: 如今它既指行为举止，也指热与电的输送。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on the same Latin lead base, and the meaning group names other ways of behaving or leading.
note.cn: 形近组收的是建立在同一拉丁词基上的词，近义组列出其他表示行为或带领的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a conductor raising a baton, then move to a research team and to a copper wire.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从举起指挥棒的人开始，再走到研究团队与一根铜线。

normal.en: Con- is together and duct- is lead, so conduct is to lead things together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，duct- 是引导，所以 conduct 就是把事情一起带着走。

normal.en: A teacher conducts a class, and a wire conducts a current.
normal.cn: 老师带领一个班级，电线传导一股电流。

normal.en: Your conduct is simply how you lead yourself in public.
normal.cn: 你的行为举止，就是你在人前带领自己的方式。

normal.en: To conduct a survey, first write down what you want to ask.
normal.cn: 要开展调查，先写下你想问的内容。

normal.en: Bad conduct at work can end a career faster than bad luck.
normal.cn: 工作中的不当行为，比运气不好更快毁掉前程。

abstract.en: Picture a baton drawing one line through the air.
abstract.cn: 想象一根指挥棒在空中划出一条线。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow pipe carrying water downhill.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细管把水引向低处。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd following one person through a gate.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人跟着一个人穿过大门。

examples.en: The school expects good conduct from every student.
examples.cn: 学校要求每位学生行为端正。

examples.en: They conducted the experiment twice to be sure.
examples.cn: 他们把这个实验做了两次以求稳妥。

examples.en: This metal conducts heat better than iron.
examples.cn: 这种金属比铁的导热性更好。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conduct 记成 con（一起）加 duct（引导）：把一群人一起带着走，是指挥与实施；把自己带着走，就是行为举止。

root: 源自拉丁语 conducere（com 一起 + ducere 引导），本义是一起带领，后引申为实施、指挥、传导与行为举止。

sensesIntro.en: From leading a group, to carrying out a study, and finally to the way one carries oneself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从带领一群人，到开展一项研究，最后到一个人立身行事的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one raised hand leads an orchestra, a team, or a current of electricity.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只举起的手，带着乐团、团队或一股电流。

branches.en: Conduct as behaviour is the self under the eyes of others.
branches.cn: 行为义项是自我在别人目光下的样子。

branches.en: To conduct a study is to lead it from question to answer.
branches.cn: 开展研究就是从问题一直领到答案。

branches.en: Leading a group and carrying a current share the same movement.
branches.cn: 带领团队与传导电流共享同一种运动。

branches.en: Good conduct helps any activity run smoothly.
branches.cn: 良好的举止能让任何活动顺利开展。

branches.en: Both senses need a clear path from one end to the other.
branches.cn: 两个义项都需要一条从一端到另一端的畅通路径。

intro.en: Conduct is built on Latin com-, together, plus ducere, to lead.
intro.cn: conduct 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 ducere（引导）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin lead base duct- also appears in product, reduce and introduce.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的引导词基 duct- 也出现在 product、reduce 与 introduce 中。

items.example: She conducted the meeting well.
items.exampleCN: 她把会议主持得很好。

items.example: He conducts research on soil.
items.exampleCN: 他从事土壤研究。

items.example: They conducted the test in silence.
items.exampleCN: 他们在安静中完成了测试。

items.example: The wire is conducting current.
items.exampleCN: 这根电线正在导电。

items.meaning: the passing of heat or electricity
items.example: Conduction carries heat along the bar.
items.exampleCN: 传导把热量沿着金属棒送过去。

items.meaning: able to carry heat or electricity
items.example: Silver is a highly conductive metal.
items.exampleCN: 银是导电性很强的金属。

items.meaning: a person who leads or a material that carries
items.example: The conductor raised both hands.
items.exampleCN: 指挥举起了双手。

items.example: The officer was dismissed for misconduct.
items.exampleCN: 这名官员因失职被免职。
